_comment: Single source of truth for all email body copy + brand chrome in this skill. Three consumers read from this shape: (1) worker/index.ts (welcome email + admin notice), (2) database/03_email_templates_table.sql (seeded order template rows — admin can edit them later in /admin/email/templates without redeploying), (3) edge-function/send-order-email/index.ts (fallback defaults when a templates row is missing). Frontend i18n strings are also derived from these brand values. After install for a new vertical, edit ONLY this file plus your i18n locale JSON, redeploy, done — no grep-and-replace.
_consumer_install_checklist: 1. Copy this file's values into worker/index.ts BRAND and CONTENT consts (or import + inline at build time).
2. Re-run database/03_email_templates_table.sql with the seed rows reflecting these values OR edit copy in /admin/email/templates after first deploy.
3. Update frontend/src/i18n/locales/{es,en}/newsletter.json + adminEmailComposer.json success/reply-to/placeholder strings to match brand.name and brand.domain.
